checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15s 16:9 film in three distinct shots
must.why: Frames show one continuous park setting with the same camera angle; no clear three-shot structure.

must.item: Woman keeps freckles and red pixie cut
must.why: Woman has long dark brown hair, no red pixie cut.

must.item: Man keeps shaved head and round glasses
must.why: Man has short brown hair and no glasses.

must.item: Both faces clearly visible in every shot
must.why: Frame 1 is distant and frame 2 is partly turned away. Frames 3 and 4 show faces well.

must.item: Red scarf dropped, picked up, returned, ending in smiles
must.why: No red scarf in any frame. The end does show mutual smiles.
Looks photoreal and the clip is silent as requested.

faults.what: Scarf story, red pixie cut, and shaved head with round glasses are all absent. The output does not match the specified characters.
The hug in frame 2 looks awkward, and the figures are small and distant in frame 1.
No distinct three-shot structure is visible.

summary: The clip is a realistic, silent park meeting of a woman and a man, but it misses the specified characters (red pixie cut, shaved head with round glasses), the scarf story and the three-shot structure.
